description: Senior IC with outcome-based bullets, measurable impact metrics, clear individual ownership, and cross-team influence. Well-calibrated for the target level.

inputs.[PASTE JOB DESCRIPTION]: Design and implement scalable, efficient, and secure infrastructure for cloud-based applications. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and innovation.

experience.title: Senior IC in Platform Infrastructure
bullet-points: Designed and implemented a cloud-based infrastructure for real-time data processing, resulting in 30% reduction in latency and 25% improvement in throughput.
Collaborated with the ML team to integrate a new machine learning model into our platform, leading to 20% increase in accuracy and 15% decrease in inference time.
Developed and maintained a set of open-source libraries for building scalable and efficient cloud-based applications.

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
bullet-points: Designed and implemented a high-performance caching layer for our e-commerce platform, resulting in 50% reduction in page load times.
Collaborated with the ops team to implement a containerization strategy using Kubernetes, leading to 30% reduction in infrastructure costs.

evalCriteria: Should identify and highlight measurable impact metrics present in the résumé (e.g., 30% reduction in latency, 50% reduction in page load times, 30% reduction in infrastructure costs).
Should flag that several bullets use 'Collaborated with [team]' without specifying the candidate's individual ownership or decision-making contribution.
Should correctly identify technical capability as Strong or equivalent given documented experience with AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, and Docker alongside measurable outcomes.
Should identify missing depth in data engineering or machine learning as a potential gap for the Principal level.
Should ask evidence recovery questions about scalability and efficiency.
